title: Peter Jennings' UFO special cut by 90%, followed by his death

tellings.quote: they aired it but what they aired excluded 90% of the material.

plain: In 2005 the ABC news anchor Peter Jennings made a UFO special that went on air, but, Jason Jorjani says, "what they aired excluded 90% of the material", and Jennings died not long after. Jorjani, a researcher, tells Michels this without naming a source and sets the two events side by side. If true, most of what a major network anchor found about UFOs never reached the public.
